title: Mall Under Your Backyard
caption:
Mall Under Your Backyard 🛍️
There's a whole mall under your lawn. The ground collapses, it's pitch dark, nobody can find it. Every problem gets a fix, and a secret mall opens behind the garden shed.

Would you shop in a secret mall? Comment below. Tag a friend who would. Follow @StickMindR8 for the next build.
